title: Material for MkDocs fonts
description: The curated font families offered for theme.font.text and theme.font.code.

id.description: The family name as written into the configuration file and requested from Google Fonts. Empty for the custom placeholder.

text.description: Whether the family is offered for theme.font.text.

code.description: Whether the family is offered for theme.font.code.

custom.description: Whether this entry is the placeholder for a family outside the curated list rather than a family of its own.
